title: Claude Agent SDK and Claude Code Interview Mock

meta.tagline: query(), permissions, hooks, MCP, subagents, sessions and headless Claude Code: what teams shipping Claude agents actually ask.
meta.description: A 450-question bank for engineers building on the Claude Agent SDK (Python claude-agent-sdk 0.2.172, TypeScript @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.308) and automating with Claude Code 2.1.x, written against the official docs at code.claude.com and platform.claude.com as of October 2026 and served as 40-question, 60-minute mocks: the query API and options, message types and streaming, built-in tools and permission modes, custom tools and MCP servers, hooks, subagents and sessions, CLAUDE.md and skills, headless mode and CI, hosting agents in a backend, and the Messages API essentials (tool use, prompt caching, thinking, batches) that the SDK sits on. Every option explains its reasoning.
